statement.description: Petya loves football very much. One day, as he was watching a football match, he was writing the players' current positions on a piece of paper. To simplify the situation he depicted it as a string consisting of zeroes and ones. A zero corresponds to players of one team; a one corresponds to players of another team. If there are at least $ 7 $ players of some team standing one after another, then the situation is considered dangerous. For example, the situation $ 00100110111111101 $ is dangerous and $ 11110111011101 $ is not. You are given the current situation. Determine whether it is dangerous or not.
statement.formatI: The first input line contains a non-empty string consisting of characters "0" and "1", which represents players. The length of the string does not exceed $ 100 $ characters. There's at least one player from each team present on the field.
statement.formatO: Print "YES" if the situation is dangerous. Otherwise, print "NO".

translation.description: Petya 非常喜欢足球。一天，他在观看一场足球比赛时，把球员们当前的位置写在了一张纸上。为了简化情况，他用一个只包含数字 $0$ 和 $1$ 的字符串来表示球场。数字 $0$ 表示一队的球员；数字 $1$ 表示另一队的球员。如果有至少 $7$ 名同一队的球员连续站在一起，那么这种情况被认为是危险的。例如，情况 $00100110111111101$ 是危险的，而 $11110111011101$ 不是。现在给出当前情况的字符串，请判断场上是否危险。
translation.formatI: 输入包含一行非空字符串，仅由字符 $0$ 和 $1$ 组成，表示球员的分布。字符串长度不超过 $100$。保证场上每队至少有一名球员。
translation.formatO: 如果情况危险，输出 "YES"；否则输出 "NO"。
